_meta.source: Curated prototype sample of Indian Standards (BIS). Titles, versions, amendments and certification status are indicative and must be verified against the BIS Standards portal before production use.

standards.title: Polyvinyl chloride insulated unsheathed and sheathed cables/cords with rigid and flexible conductor for rated voltages up to and including 450/750 V
standards.scope: Covers PVC insulated single-core and multi-core house wiring cables and flexible cords with copper or aluminium conductors for fixed wiring in buildings, panels and appliances.

certification.instrument: Electrical Wires, Cables, Appliances and Protection Devices and Accessories (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: PVC insulated (heavy duty) electric cables - Part 1: For working voltages up to and including 1100 V
standards.scope: Covers PVC insulated, PVC sheathed, armoured and unarmoured heavy duty power and control cables with copper or aluminium conductors for 1100 V distribution.

certification.instrument: Electrical Wires, Cables, Appliances and Protection Devices and Accessories (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Crosslinked polyethylene insulated PVC sheathed cables - Part 1: For working voltage up to and including 1100 V
standards.scope: Covers XLPE insulated, PVC sheathed armoured and unarmoured power cables with copper or aluminium conductors for LT distribution and industrial use.

certification.instrument: Electrical Wires, Cables, Appliances and Protection Devices and Accessories (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Conductors for insulated electric cables and flexible cords
standards.scope: Specifies classes, nominal cross-sectional areas, number of wires and maximum DC resistance of copper and aluminium conductors used in cables and cords.

standards.title: PVC insulation and sheath of electric cables
standards.scope: Specifies the requirements of PVC compounds used for insulation and sheath of electric cables.

standards.title: Low carbon galvanized steel wires, formed wires and tapes for armouring of cables
standards.scope: Covers galvanized steel round wires, formed wires and tapes used for armouring electric cables.

standards.title: Methods of test for cables
standards.scope: Multi-part series of test methods for electric cables: conductor resistance, insulation resistance, high voltage test, tensile strength, elongation, thermal ageing, flammability and armour tests.

standards.title: Electrotechnical vocabulary - Part 32: Electric cables
standards.scope: Defines terms relating to electric cables, conductors and their accessories.

standards.title: Code of practice for electrical wiring installations
standards.scope: Covers design, selection, erection, inspection and testing of low voltage electrical wiring installations in residential, commercial and industrial buildings.

standards.title: Code of practice for installation and maintenance of power cables up to and including 33 kV rating
standards.scope: Gives guidance on laying, jointing, terminating, testing and maintenance of power cables in ground, ducts, trays and buildings.

standards.title: Code of practice for earthing
standards.scope: Gives guidance on methods of earthing of electrical installations and equipment for safety and system performance.

standards.title: Electrical accessories - Circuit-breakers for overcurrent protection for household and similar installations - Part 1: Circuit-breakers for AC operation
standards.scope: Applies to AC miniature circuit breakers (MCB) up to 440 V and 125 A for overcurrent protection in household and similar installations.

certification.instrument: Electrical Wires, Cables, Appliances and Protection Devices and Accessories (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Residual current operated circuit-breakers without integral overcurrent protection for household and similar uses (RCCBs) - Part 1: General rules
standards.scope: Covers RCCBs for household and similar use for protection against electric shock and earth leakage.

certification.instrument: Electrical Wires, Cables, Appliances and Protection Devices and Accessories (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Switches for domestic and similar purposes
standards.scope: Covers manually operated general purpose switches for AC fixed electrical installations, indoor or outdoor, up to 440 V and 63 A.

certification.instrument: Electrical Wires, Cables, Appliances and Protection Devices and Accessories (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Plugs and socket-outlets of rated voltage up to and including 250 volts and rated current up to and including 16 amperes
standards.scope: Covers 2-pin and 3-pin plugs and socket-outlets, including modular types, for household and similar purposes.

certification.instrument: Electrical Wires, Cables, Appliances and Protection Devices and Accessories (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Self-ballasted LED lamps for general lighting services - Part 1: Safety requirements
standards.scope: Specifies safety and interchangeability requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps (LED bulbs) with E27/B22 caps for domestic and general lighting above 50 V.

certification.instrument: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2012 (MeitY)

standards.title: Self-ballasted LED lamps for general lighting services - Part 2: Performance requirements
standards.scope: Specifies performance requirements such as luminous efficacy, colour rendering, lumen maintenance and life for self-ballasted LED lamps.

standards.title: Luminaires - Part 5: Particular requirements - Section 3: Luminaires for road and street lighting
standards.scope: Specifies safety requirements for luminaires for road, street and outdoor public lighting including LED street lights.

certification.instrument: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2012 (MeitY)

standards.title: Luminaires performance - Part 2: Particular requirements - Section 1: LED luminaires
standards.scope: Specifies performance requirements of LED luminaires including efficacy, power factor, THD and lumen maintenance.

standards.title: Safety of lamp controlgear - Part 2: Particular requirements - Section 13: DC or AC supplied electronic controlgear for LED modules
standards.scope: Specifies safety requirements for LED drivers (electronic control gear) used with LED modules.

certification.instrument: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2012 (MeitY)

standards.title: Method of electrical and photometric measurements of solid-state lighting (LED) products
standards.scope: Describes methods for measuring electrical and photometric characteristics of LED lamps, modules and luminaires.

standards.title: High strength deformed steel bars and wires for concrete reinforcement - Specification
standards.scope: Covers requirements of deformed steel bars and wires (TMT bars) of grades Fe 415, Fe 500, Fe 550, Fe 600 and their D/S variants for reinforcement of concrete.

certification.instrument: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Hot rolled medium and high tensile structural steel - Specification
standards.scope: Covers steel plates, strips, sections, flats and bars of grades E250 to E650 for structural use in buildings, bridges and fabrication.

certification.instrument: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Metallic materials - Tensile testing - Part 1: Method of test at room temperature
standards.scope: Specifies the method for tensile testing of metallic materials and the mechanical properties determined at room temperature.

standards.title: Metallic materials - Bend test
standards.scope: Specifies a method of bend testing metallic materials to determine ductility.

standards.title: Methods for chemical analysis of steels
standards.scope: Multi-part series specifying methods for determining carbon, sulphur, phosphorus, manganese and other elements in steel.

standards.title: Code of practice for bending and fixing of bars for concrete reinforcement
standards.scope: Gives guidance on cutting, bending, placing and fixing of reinforcement bars.

standards.title: General construction in steel - Code of practice
standards.scope: Covers design of steel structures using limit state and working stress methods.

standards.title: Steel tubes, tubulars and other wrought steel fittings - Part 1: Steel tubes
standards.scope: Covers welded and seamless mild steel tubes, black or galvanized, light, medium and heavy grades for water, gas, steam and structural use.

certification.instrument: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Steel tubes for structural purposes - Specification
standards.scope: Covers welded and seamless steel tubes for structural applications such as scaffolding, towers, trusses and frames.

certification.instrument: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Hot-dip zinc coatings on mild steel tubes
standards.scope: Specifies requirements of hot-dip zinc (galvanized) coating on mild steel tubes.

standards.title: Ordinary Portland cement - Specification
standards.scope: Covers chemical and physical requirements of 33, 43 and 53 grade ordinary Portland cement.

certification.instrument: Cement (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Portland pozzolana cement - Specification - Part 1: Fly ash based
standards.scope: Covers fly ash based Portland pozzolana cement (PPC) for general construction.

certification.instrument: Cement (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Methods of physical tests for hydraulic cement
standards.scope: Multi-part series covering fineness, consistency, setting time, soundness and compressive strength of cement.

standards.title: Method of chemical analysis of hydraulic cement
standards.scope: Specifies methods for chemical analysis of hydraulic cement.

standards.title: Coarse and fine aggregate for concrete - Specification
standards.scope: Covers natural and manufactured coarse and fine aggregates (sand, M-sand, gravel) for concrete.

standards.title: Plain and reinforced concrete - Code of practice
standards.scope: Covers general structural use of plain and reinforced concrete including materials, workmanship, durability and design.

standards.title: Common burnt clay building bricks - Specification
standards.scope: Covers dimensions, classes, compressive strength, water absorption and efflorescence of burnt clay bricks.

standards.title: Burnt clay building bricks - Methods of tests
standards.scope: Covers determination of compressive strength, water absorption, efflorescence and warpage of bricks.

standards.title: Concrete masonry units - Part 1: Hollow and solid concrete blocks
standards.scope: Covers hollow and solid concrete blocks used in masonry construction.

standards.title: Pressed ceramic tiles - Specification
standards.scope: Covers dry-pressed ceramic floor and wall tiles including vitrified tiles, classified by water absorption.

standards.title: Ceramic tiles - Methods of test, sampling and basis for acceptance
standards.scope: Multi-part series covering dimensions, water absorption, breaking strength, abrasion and chemical resistance of ceramic tiles.

standards.title: Unplasticized PVC pipes for water supplies - Specification
standards.scope: Covers uPVC pipes of pressure classes 2.5 to 10 kgf/cm2 for potable water supply, irrigation and distribution mains.

standards.title: Polyethylene pipes for water supply - Specification
standards.scope: Covers HDPE pipes of PE 63, PE 80 and PE 100 grades for potable water supply and distribution.

standards.title: Chlorinated polyvinyl chloride (CPVC) pipes for potable hot and cold water distribution supplies - Specification
standards.scope: Covers CPVC pipes for hot and cold potable water plumbing in buildings.

standards.title: Thermoplastics pipes and fittings - Methods of test
standards.scope: Multi-part series of test methods: dimensions, hydrostatic pressure, reversion, impact, vicat softening temperature.

standards.title: Plastics pipes selection, handling, storage and installation for potable water supplies - Code of practice - Part 3: Laying and jointing of uPVC pipes
standards.scope: Gives guidance on trenching, laying, jointing and field testing of uPVC water pipes.

standards.title: Drinking water - Specification
standards.scope: Specifies acceptable and permissible limits of physical, chemical, bacteriological and radioactive parameters for drinking water supply.

standards.title: Packaged drinking water (other than packaged natural mineral water) - Specification
standards.scope: Covers requirements of packaged drinking water in bottles, jars and pouches including microbiological and chemical limits.

certification.instrument: FSS (Prohibition and Restrictions on Sales) Regulations - BIS certification mandatory

standards.title: Packaged natural mineral water - Specification
standards.scope: Covers requirements of natural mineral water packaged for drinking.

certification.instrument: FSS (Prohibition and Restrictions on Sales) Regulations - BIS certification mandatory

standards.title: Methods of sampling and test (physical and chemical) for water and wastewater
standards.scope: Multi-part series of methods for sampling and testing pH, turbidity, TDS, hardness, metals and other parameters of water.

standards.title: Safety of household and similar electrical appliances - Part 1: General requirements
standards.scope: Specifies general safety requirements of electrical appliances for household and similar purposes with rated voltage up to 250 V single phase.

standards.title: Stationary storage type electric water heaters - Specification
standards.scope: Covers storage type electric water heaters (geysers) of capacity up to 200 litres for domestic and similar use.

certification.instrument: Electrical Wires, Cables, Appliances and Protection Devices and Accessories (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Room air conditioners - Specification - Part 1: Unitary air conditioners
standards.scope: Covers window type unitary room air conditioners including performance and safety requirements.

certification.instrument: Air Conditioner and its Related Parts, Hermetic Compressor and Temperature Sensing Controls (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Room air conditioners - Specification - Part 2: Split air conditioners
standards.scope: Covers split type room air conditioners (wall mounted, ceiling, floor) including performance requirements.

certification.instrument: Air Conditioner and its Related Parts, Hermetic Compressor and Temperature Sensing Controls (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Self-contained drinking water coolers - Specification - Part 1: Requirements
standards.scope: Covers storage and instantaneous type electric drinking water coolers for offices, schools and public places.

standards.title: Domestic pressure cookers - Specification
standards.scope: Covers aluminium, stainless steel and hard anodized domestic pressure cookers.

certification.instrument: Domestic Pressure Cooker (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Domestic gas stoves for use with liquefied petroleum gases - Specification
standards.scope: Covers construction, safety and performance of domestic LPG stoves with one or more burners.

certification.instrument: Domestic Gas Stoves for use with LPG (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Welded low carbon steel cylinders exceeding 5 litre water capacity for low pressure liquefiable gases - Part 1: Cylinders for LPG
standards.scope: Covers welded steel cylinders for storage and transport of LPG.

certification.instrument: Gas Cylinder Rules / Quality Control Order

standards.title: Information technology equipment - Safety - Part 1: General requirements
standards.scope: Specifies safety requirements of IT equipment such as laptops, desktops, monitors, printers, servers and adapters.

certification.instrument: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2012 (MeitY)

standards.title: Audio, video and similar electronic apparatus - Safety requirements
standards.scope: Specifies safety requirements for audio, video and similar electronic apparatus such as TVs, set-top boxes, speakers and amplifiers.

certification.instrument: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2012 (MeitY)

standards.title: Secondary cells and batteries containing alkaline or other non-acid electrolytes - Safety requirements - Part 2: Lithium systems
standards.scope: Specifies safety requirements for portable sealed lithium-ion cells and batteries used in laptops, mobiles and power banks.

certification.instrument: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2012 (MeitY)

standards.title: Crystalline silicon terrestrial photovoltaic (PV) modules - Design qualification and type approval
standards.scope: Specifies design qualification and type approval tests for crystalline silicon PV modules for long-term outdoor operation.

certification.instrument: Solar Photovoltaics, Systems, Devices and Components Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order (MNRE)

standards.title: Photovoltaic (PV) module safety qualification - Part 1: Requirements for construction
standards.scope: Specifies construction requirements for PV modules to provide safe electrical and mechanical operation.

certification.instrument: Solar Photovoltaics, Systems, Devices and Components Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order (MNRE)

standards.title: Safety of power converters for use in photovoltaic power systems - Part 2: Particular requirements for inverters
standards.scope: Specifies safety requirements for solar inverters used in PV power systems.

certification.instrument: Solar Photovoltaics, Systems, Devices and Components Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order (MNRE)

standards.title: Protective helmets for two-wheeler riders - Specification
standards.scope: Covers requirements for protective helmets for riders and passengers of motorcycles and scooters.

certification.instrument: Helmet for Riders of Two Wheelers Motor Vehicles (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Industrial safety helmets - Specification
standards.scope: Covers plastic safety helmets for use in industry, construction sites and mines.

standards.title: Personal protective equipment - Part 2: Safety footwear
standards.scope: Specifies basic and additional requirements for safety footwear with toe protection against impact and compression.

standards.title: Portable fire extinguishers - Performance and construction - Specification
standards.scope: Covers construction and performance of portable fire extinguishers (water, foam, CO2, ABC dry powder).

certification.instrument: Fire Extinguishers (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Selection, installation and maintenance of first-aid fire extinguishers - Code of practice
standards.scope: Guides selection, siting, installation, inspection and maintenance of portable fire extinguishers.

standards.title: Safety of toys - Part 1: Safety aspects related to mechanical and physical properties
standards.scope: Specifies mechanical and physical safety requirements for toys intended for children under 14 years.

certification.instrument: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020

standards.title: Safety of electric toys
standards.scope: Specifies safety requirements for toys having at least one function dependent on electricity.

certification.instrument: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020

standards.title: Gold and gold alloys, jewellery/artefacts - Fineness and marking - Specification
standards.scope: Specifies fineness grades (14K, 18K, 20K, 22K, 23K, 24K) and marking requirements for gold jewellery and artefacts.

certification.instrument: Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery and Gold Artefacts Order, 2020

standards.title: Assaying of gold in gold bullion, gold alloys and gold jewellery/artefacts - Cupellation (fire assay) method
standards.scope: Specifies the fire assay method for determining gold fineness.

standards.title: Precious metal articles - Assaying and hallmarking centres - Requirements
standards.scope: Specifies infrastructure and operational requirements for assaying and hallmarking centres.

standards.title: Silver and silver alloys, jewellery/artefacts - Fineness and marking - Specification
standards.scope: Specifies fineness grades and marking requirements for silver jewellery and artefacts.

certification.instrument: Voluntary hallmarking

standards.title: Automotive vehicles - Pneumatic tyres for passenger car vehicles - Diagonal and radial ply - Specification
standards.scope: Covers dimensional, performance and marking requirements of passenger car tyres.

certification.instrument: Pneumatic Tyres and Tubes for Automotive Vehicles (Quality Control) Order

standards.title: Furniture - Office chairs - Specification
standards.scope: Covers dimensional, strength, durability and stability requirements for office work chairs.

certification.instrument: QCO notified for furniture - verify applicable enforcement date

standards.title: Furniture - Office tables and desks - Specification
standards.scope: Covers dimensional, strength and stability requirements of office tables, desks and workstations.

certification.instrument: QCO notified for furniture - verify applicable enforcement date

standards.title: Writing and printing paper - Specification
standards.scope: Covers writing and printing paper including maplitho and copier paper by grammage and quality.

standards.title: Random sampling and randomization procedures
standards.scope: Gives procedures for random selection of samples from lots for inspection and testing.

standards.title: Sampling procedures for inspection by attributes - Part 1: Sampling schemes indexed by acceptance quality limit (AQL) for lot-by-lot inspection
standards.scope: Specifies attribute sampling plans indexed by AQL for acceptance inspection of lots.
